sloka: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने ।पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः ।। ५.६८.११ ।।८.१० ।।।।
transliteration: kāmamasya tvamevaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane ।paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyaste balodayaḥ ।। 5.68.11 ।।8.10 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O Slayer of enemy heroes you have the ability to accomplsh this task singlehanded. By succeeding in accomplishing the objective you will become renowned (and not Rama).
